data.answer: ShipBob has introduced ShipBob AI, an end-to-end suite that incorporates artificial intelligence across its entire fulfillment stack, from the software merchants use to the robots in the warehouse. This AI suite includes the ShipBob MCP and an Anthropic-verified Claude connector, which are now available. The ShipBob AI Hub is live in the dashboard, and Bobby, the AI agent, is in beta with general availability planned for Fall 2026. Autonomous mobile robots are rolling out at ShipBob's Midwest hub, and AI-based returns grading is in development with a preview later this year.

#### ShipBob launches in the Netherlands

Global fulfilment platform ShipBob is expanding to the Netherlands with the launch of a fulfilment centre. The new fulfilment centre is the company’s fifth European location. The company expects to start shipping parcels from the new location in July.

#### America’s Most Innovative Companies 2023 [...] ShipBob announced that Gail Goodman has joined the ShipBob Board of Directors. results.title: ShipBob adds Claude-integrated AI to in-house fulfillment tech suite
results.content: ShipBob said it has built its fulfillment technology stack internally. That stack can now “bring an end-to-end AI layer across its entire operations,” the company said in its announcement. It includes ShipBob’s model context protocol (MCP), which is what allows it to connect to merchants’ operations. An MCP is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external systems. [...] Global supply chain and fulfillment platform ShipBob has introduced an artificial intelligence (AI) suite to connect to merchants’ live operations using either its agent, Bobby, or Anthropic’s Claude. [...] “A new ShipBob AI Hub is where merchants learn about ShipBob AI, connect their own tools, and see every action AI takes on their account,” the company said. “The same intelligence runs on the warehouse floor, where autonomous mobile robots take on the physical legwork and AI-powered cameras grade returns as they arrive. It is one operation, from the software a merchant works in to the machines on the floor, getting smarter at once.”
